query: UPDATE users SET failed_pin_attempts = failed_pin_attempts+1, pin_locked_until = CASE WHEN failed_pin_attempts+1 >= 5 THEN NOW() + interval '15 minutes' WHEN failed_pin_attempts+1 >= 3 THEN NOW() + interval '2 minutes' ELSE pin_locked_until END WHERE id=$1 RETURNING failed_pin_attempts, pin_locked_until
